dataformat.name: dfdl
dataformat.title: DFDL
dataformat.description: Transforms fixed format data such as EDI message from/to XML using a Data Format Description Language (DFDL)
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: The XML infoset of the DFDL schema, as text or as a DOM Document (or another DOM Node or Source), which is converted to a DOM Document

marshalOut.description: The data in the format the DFDL schema describes, in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: Data in the format the DFDL schema describes, such as an EDI message

unmarshalOut.description: The XML infoset as a DOM Document

schemaUri.description: The path to the DFDL schema file.

rootElement.label: advanced
rootElement.description: The root element name of the schema to use. If not specified, the first root element in the schema will be used.

rootNamespace.label: advanced
rootNamespace.description: The root namespace of the schema to use.
